description: Bring a PR branch up to date with its base: merge the base into the head server-side (the PR page's 'Update branch'). Never a force-push — the new head is a merge commit moved through the push gates, so it gets CI. On conflict nothing changes and `conflictFiles` lists the paths. Requires write access and 'repo' scope. Returns {ok, status: 'updated'|'up-to-date', headSha, previousHeadSha, baseSha, url} or {ok: false, reason, message, conflictFiles}.

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: gluecron_update_pr_branch
